ChunkNumber.description: Folder number the exported model is found in

FileIndex.description: 0-based index of this entry within the ChunkNumber's file list in the main.dol directory table. Combined with ChunkNumber, uniquely identifies the DOL entry to patch for Hammerspace.

ModelOffset.description: Starting offset of model data in dt_na.dat (hex)

ModelLength.description: Full length of model data (in bytes) from offset adress to end of model data

UseBase64.description: Whether to use Base64 encoding for binary data buffers. If false, binary data will be represented as arrays of byte values. Base64 is more compact and human-readable for large buffers, but raw byte arrays may be more convenient for small buffers or when editing the JSON by hand.

GPLUserDataLength.description: Byte length of the GPL header user-data block (GPL header +0x04). Zero when no user data is present.

GPLUserData.description: Base64-encoded raw bytes of the GPL header user-data block (GPL header +0x08). Null when GPLUserDataLength is zero.

Submeshes.description: There can be multiple separate submeshes in one model.

MeshName.description: Mesh name string from the GEO descriptor (GEO descriptor +0x04 section-relative pointer to null-terminated string). Used when reassembling the mesh block in hammerspace.

SubmeshOffset.description: Starting offset of this submesh in dt_na.dat (hex)

SubmeshLength.description: Length of this submesh data in bytes

FacesData.description: Base64-encoded face index buffer. Packed as big-endian uint16 triplets: [i0, i1, i2, i0, i1, i2, ...]

FaceTextureIndices.description: Base64-encoded per-face primary texture index buffer. Packed as big-endian uint16, one entry per face. Records which TPL texture (index into TextureDescriptors) was active on UV channel 0 when each face was drawn. Used to assign Blender material slots.

VertexBuffer.description: XYZ position vertex buffer for this submesh

VertexBufferOffset.description: Starting offset of the vertex position buffer in dt_na.dat (hex)

VertexBufferLength.description: Length of the vertex position buffer in bytes

VertexBufferCompCount.description: Number of components per vertex entry. 3 = XYZ only, 6 = XYZ+NormalXYZ interleaved (skinned meshes)

VertexBufferQuantizeInfo.description: Quantization byte. High nibble = data format (0/3=s16, 4=float), low nibble = right-shift divisor exponent

VertexBufferData.description: Base64-encoded raw vertex position buffer bytes

VertexBufferDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded raw vertex position buffer bytes, after editing in Blender.

UVChannels.description: One entry per texture channel in the submesh (matches numTextureChannels from the mesh data header).

UVChannelIndex.description: Zero-based texture channel index (0 = texture0, 1 = texture1, …)

PaletteName.description: Palette/texture name string from the UV map data header

TextureIndex.description: Index into TextureDescriptors of the texture bound to this UV channel (from draw-list Type-1 state entry)

WrapS.description: GX wrap mode for the S (U) axis (4-bit value from draw-list Type-1 state entry)

WrapT.description: GX wrap mode for the T (V) axis (4-bit value from draw-list Type-1 state entry)

UVChannelOffset.description: Starting offset of the ST coordinate array in dt_na.dat (hex)

UVChannelLength.description: Byte length of the raw ST coordinate array

UVChannelCompCount.description: Number of components per UV entry (typically 2 for ST)

UVChannelQuantizeInfo.description: Quantization byte for UV coords. High nibble = data format (0/3=s16, 4=float), low nibble = right-shift divisor exponent

UVFacesData.description: Base64-encoded UV index buffer, packed as big-endian uint16 triplets aligned face-for-face with FacesData. Index 0 = first ST coord entry.

UVChannelData.description: Base64-encoded raw ST coordinate buffer (original game data)

UVChannelDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded raw ST coordinate buffer after editing in Blender, written into the same slot positions as UVChannelData so existing draw-list UV indices remain valid. Absent until first export from Blender.

UVDataPtrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the ST coordinate data pointer field within the DOTextureDataHeader in dt_na.dat (hex). Patched by writeExpandedMesh to redirect this UV channel's ST array into hammerspace.

UVCountFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the ST coordinate count field within the DOTextureDataHeader in dt_na.dat (hex). Updated to the new coord count after a hammerspace relocation.

UVFacesDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded UV index buffer for the edited face set, packed as big-endian uint16 triplets aligned face-for-face with FacesDataEdited. Written by the Blender exporter in Hammerspace Mode when UV seam layout or face count changes. Absent for in-place exports.

NormalBuffer.description: Separate normal/lighting data array for non-skinned meshes (DOLightingHeader at DOLayout +0x0c). Absent for skinned meshes (CompCount=6), which interleave normals in VertexBuffer.

NormalDataPtrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the normalsPtr field in the DOLightingHeader struct (hex). Located at DOLightingHeader.absolute + 0x0. Patched to redirect the normal array into hammerspace.

NormalCountFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the numNormals field in the DOLightingHeader struct (hex). Located at DOLightingHeader.absolute + 0x4. Updated to the new normal count after hammerspace relocation.

NormalBufferOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the raw normal data array in dt_na.dat (hex).

NormalBufferLength.description: Byte length of the raw normal data array.

NormalBufferCompCount.description: Number of components per normal entry (typically 3 for XYZ).

NormalBufferQuantizeInfo.description: Quantization byte for normal data. High nibble = data format, low nibble = right-shift divisor exponent.

NormalAmbientPct.description: Ambient lighting percentage stored at DOLightingHeader +0x08 (big-endian float). Preserved verbatim during hammerspace assembly.

NormalBufferData.description: Base64-encoded raw normal data array bytes (original game data).

NormalFacesData.description: Base64-encoded per-loop normal (lighting) index buffer from the draw list, packed as big-endian uint16 values aligned loop-for-loop with FacesData. Written when the active Type-3 descriptor carries a lighting index; absent for meshes without one.

NormalBufferDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded normal data array after editing in Blender. In Hammerspace Mode the Blender exporter writes one expanded entry per loop of FacesDataEdited (no deduplication); the patcher compacts/deduplicates it exactly as for UVChannelDataEdited. Absent for in-place exports.

NormalFacesDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded per-loop normal index buffer for the edited face set, packed as big-endian uint16 values aligned loop-for-loop with FacesDataEdited. The Blender exporter writes an identity mapping (one normal per loop); the patcher rewrites compact indices after deduplication. Absent for in-place exports.

ColorChannels.description: One entry per active vertex color channel (color0 and/or color1). Absent when no vertex colors are used.

ColorDataPtrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the color array pointer field within the DOColorHeader in dt_na.dat (hex). Shared by all color channels pointing to the same header. Used by PatchGPLUVRebuild to redirect the color buffer into appended space.

ColorCountFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the color count field (uint16) within the DOColorHeader in dt_na.dat (hex). Shared by all color channels. Updated when the compact color array has a different entry count.

ColorChannelOffset.description: Starting offset of the vertex color array in dt_na.dat (hex)

ColorChannelLength.description: Byte length of the raw vertex color array

ColorChannelCompCount.description: Component count from the DOColorHeader (informational; actual entry size is determined by the format nibble of ColorChannelQuantizeInfo)

ColorChannelQuantizeInfo.description: Quantization byte for color data. High nibble = color format (0=RGB565, 1=RGB8, 2=RGBA8, 3=RGBA4444, 4=RGB8, 5=RGBA8)

ColorChannelData.description: Base64-encoded raw vertex color buffer (original game data)

ColorFacesData.description: Base64-encoded color index buffer, packed as big-endian uint16 triplets aligned face-for-face with FacesData.

ColorChannelDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded vertex color buffer after editing in Blender. In Hammerspace Mode the Blender exporter writes one expanded entry per loop of FacesDataEdited (no deduplication); the patcher compacts/deduplicates it exactly as for UVChannelDataEdited. Absent for in-place exports.

ColorFacesDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded per-loop color index buffer for the edited face set, packed as big-endian uint16 values aligned loop-for-loop with FacesDataEdited. The Blender exporter writes an identity mapping (one color per loop); the patcher rewrites compact indices after deduplication. Absent for in-place exports.

PositionDataPtrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the vertex position data pointer field within the DOPositionHeader in dt_na.dat (hex). Patched by writeExpandedMesh to redirect the vertex position buffer into hammerspace.

VertexCountFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the vertex count field within the DOPositionHeader in dt_na.dat (hex). Updated to the new vertex count after a hammerspace relocation.

FacesDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded face index buffer for the edited mesh, packed as big-endian uint16 triplets. Written by the Blender exporter in Hammerspace Mode. Absent for in-place exports.

FacesCountEdited.description: Number of triangle faces in the edited mesh. Written by the Blender exporter in Hammerspace Mode. Absent for in-place exports.

FaceTextureIndicesEdited.description: Base64-encoded per-face primary texture index buffer for the edited face set, packed as big-endian uint16 (one entry per face). Used by _rebuild_draw_states to route edited faces to the correct draw state by texture index. Absent for in-place exports.

FaceSurfaceIdsEdited.description: Base64-encoded per-face draw-state index, packed as big-endian uint16 (one entry per face). Each value is the index into the DisplayStates array of the draw state that owns this face. Written by the Blender exporter when any face has been reassigned to a different surface material. Absent when face-to-surface assignment is unchanged. Used by the hammerspace GPL rebuild to route faces to the correct primitive list.

DrawStates.description: One entry per display state (draw batch) in this submesh. Provides pointer-field offsets for writeExpandedMesh to relocate each primitive list into hammerspace, and the original data for --unpatch restoration.

DisplayStateId.description: ID byte of this display state from the DODisplayState header.

SurfaceId.description: Stable surface identity in the form 'sm{submesh_idx}_ds{ds_idx}'. Keyed by position in the Submeshes and DisplayStates arrays; independent of Blender material slot order or name. Used by the Blender add-on to key per-draw-state editable properties.

FaceCount.description: Number of triangulated faces contributed by this draw state. Zero for non-Type-7 states. Used by the Blender importer to assign one material per draw state (faces are ordered to match draw-state sequence).

ShaderModeFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the setting/shader-mode uint32 field in the DODisplayState struct (hex). Located at DODisplayState.absolute + 4.

ShaderMode.description: The 4-byte setting bitmap decoded as a FourCC ASCII string (e.g. 'TOON') or hex string when non-printable. Stored verbatim during hammerspace assembly.

PrimListPtrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the primitiveListPtr field within the DODisplayState struct in dt_na.dat (hex). Located at DODisplayState.absolute + 8. Patched to redirect the primitive list into hammerspace.

PrimListSizeFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the primitiveListSize field within the DODisplayState struct in dt_na.dat (hex). Located at DODisplayState.absolute + 12. Updated to the new byte length after hammerspace relocation.

PrimListAbsoluteOffset.description: Resolved absolute file offset of the original primitive list data in dt_na.dat (hex). Used by the --unpatch path to restore the primitiveListPtr field.

PrimListLength.description: Byte length of the original primitive list. Used by the --unpatch path to restore the primitiveListSize field.

PrimListData.description: Base64-encoded original primitive list bytes (raw GX display list draw commands for this draw batch).

VertexStreamLayout.description: Vertex attribute descriptors active in this draw state. Each entry names one attribute stream and its per-index byte size. Used by decodeDrawList and rebuildDrawList.

index_size.description: Byte size of one index entry for this attribute in the display list (1 or 2).

TEXHeader.description: TEXPalette section header fields. Null for purely static meshes that have no TEX section.

CLUTCount.description: Number of CLUT (palette) entries in the TEX section header (uint16 at TEXPalette +0x02, field numCLUTsMaybe). In practice equals the number of textures that have a palette (PaletteEntries > 0), but stored verbatim for exact reconstruction.

TextureDescriptors.description: One entry per texture in the model's TPL section. Provides dimensions, format, and file offsets needed to validate and write back image data. Raw pixel and palette bytes are NOT stored here; at hammerspace assembly time they are copied directly from the input dt_na.dat using ImageDataOffset/ImageDataLength and PaletteDataOffset/PaletteDataLength.

TextureIndex.description: Zero-based index of this texture in the TPL section

TextureFileName.description: File name of this texture's PNG in the model's tex/ folder (e.g. '0.png'). Emitted by export.py; used as the file contract for in-place texture re-import. Optional so legacy .sluggie files without it remain valid; required at patch time only when ReimportTextures is true.

TextureDescriptorOffset.description: File offset of the 0x20-byte TEXDescriptor struct in dt_na.dat (hex)

PaletteEntries.description: Number of palette color entries (0 if no palette)

EdgeLODEnable.description: Whether edge LOD bias is enabled

Unpacked.description: 'unpacked' byte at TEXDescriptor +0x0f. Preserved verbatim in the reconstructed descriptor.

DescUnknownAt10.description: Base64-encoded 7 bytes at TEXDescriptor +0x10–+0x16 (a discarded word at +0x10 followed by three discarded bytes at +0x14). Likely sampler state (LOD bias, wrap mode, etc.). Preserved verbatim.

DescUnknownAt1B.description: Base64-encoded 5 bytes at TEXDescriptor +0x1b–+0x1f (one discarded byte at +0x1b followed by four discarded bytes at +0x1c). Preserved verbatim.

AdditionalMipCount.description: Number of additional mip levels stored beyond the base image (byte at TEXDescriptor +0x16, the last byte of DescUnknownAt10). MipLevelCount = AdditionalMipCount + 1; level zero is the base image. MinLOD/MaxLOD are sampler metadata and do not determine this count. Zero for base-only textures.

ImageDataOffset.description: File offset of the raw image pixel data in dt_na.dat (hex)

ImageDataLength.description: LEGACY: byte capacity from this image pointer to the next greater image or palette pointer (next-pointer delta). This is a capacity, not a reliable payload length: it can exceed the actual image payload when the pointer aliases a larger, differently shaped texture. Kept for backward compatibility; use ImagePayloadLength for the exact stored payload length and ImageDataCapacity for the capacity.

ImagePayloadLength.description: Exact byte length of the stored image payload: the sum of the encoded byte lengths of mip levels zero through AdditionalMipCount, using the per-format storage-unit table (I4/C4: 8x8/32B, I8/IA4/C8: 8x4/32B, IA8/RGB565/RGB5A3/C14X2: 4x4/32B, RGBA8: 4x4/64B, CMPR: 4x4/8B) and level dimensions max(1, floor(Width/2^i)) x max(1, floor(Height/2^i)). This is the authoritative length for in-place texture patching; it is always <= ImageDataCapacity.

ImageDataCapacity.description: Byte capacity of the image buffer region: the legacy next-pointer delta (identical to ImageDataLength). Bytes between ImagePayloadLength and ImageDataCapacity belong to the buffer but not to this descriptor's image payload and must be preserved when patching.

PaletteDataOffset.description: File offset of the palette data in dt_na.dat (hex). Present only when a palette exists.

PaletteDataLength.description: Byte length of the palette data. Present only when a palette exists.

FacialPoseData.description: Optional facial vertex-animation section referenced by model header +0x18 (ptr7). Contains indexed position and normal pose arrays that overwrite mapped GPL vertices at runtime. The pose count is stored in the section and is not assumed to be fixed. Null when ptr7 is absent or does not use the recognized facial layout.

SectionOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the facial pose section in dt_na.dat (hex).

HeaderFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of model header +0x18, the block-relative facial section pointer field (hex).

SectionLength.description: Complete facial section length in bytes.

SectionData.description: Complete original facial section bytes for lossless preservation, encoded as base64 or a debug byte array.

HeaderData.description: Original bytes from the facial section start through the object table pointer, encoded as base64 or a debug byte array.

PoseCount.description: Maximum pose count advertised by the section (uint16 at section +0x00). Each object stores its actual PoseCount independently.

AttributeTypeCount.description: Section-level attribute type/descriptor count (uint16 at section +0x04).

ObjectCount.description: Number of facial objects (uint16 at section +0x02).

ObjectTableOffset.description: Section-relative offset of the 12-byte facial object table entries (hex).

Objects.description: Decoded facial objects. Pose count, attribute count, and record size are stored independently per object.

TableEntryOffset.description: Section-relative offset of this object's 12-byte table entry (hex).

TableEntryAbsoluteOffset.description: Absolute file offset of this object's table entry (hex).

TableEntryData.description: Original 12-byte object table entry, encoded as base64 or a debug byte array.

ObjectDataOffset.description: Section-relative offset of the paired position/normal attribute records (hex).

ObjectDataAbsoluteOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the paired position/normal attribute records (hex).

PoseCount.description: Number of poses in every attribute of this object (uint16 at table entry +0x00).

AttributeCount.description: Number of attribute records for this object (uint16 at table entry +0x02).

AttributeRecordSize.description: Per-attribute record size from table entry +0x04; equals 0x0C + PoseCount * 4.

SubmeshIndex.description: Index into SluggiesModel.Submeshes matched using pose-zero positions and normals, or null when no exact match is found.

MeshName.description: Matched GPL mesh name, or null when SubmeshIndex is null.

Normal.description: Separate normal attribute, or null when normals are interleaved in the six-component Position attribute.

FacialPoseDataEdited.description: Sparse facial position-pose edits written by the Blender exporter. Absent when every facial shape key quantizes to its original PoseData. Normal poses remain preserved by FacialPoseData because Blender shape keys do not store per-pose normals.

ObjectIndex.description: ObjectIndex of the corresponding FacialPoseData object.

PoseIndex.description: Zero-based pose index, less than the corresponding facial object's PoseCount.

PoseData.description: Edited position-attribute pose bytes. Length equals EntryCount * ComponentCount * ComponentSize. Pose 0 contains absolute values; later poses contain displacement vectors relative to Basis. Components after XYZ are preserved unchanged.

SkinData.description: Skinning control block (SKN section) for this model. Present only for skinned models that use the SKN/SK1/SK2/SKAcc deformation pipeline. Absent (null) for static meshes.

SKNOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the SKN header struct in dt_na.dat (hex). All pointer fields inside the SKN section are stored relative to this address.

GplBaseOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the GPL (geometry palette library) section (hex). Used to derive GPL-relative vertex indices from gplVertexArr values.

MemClrPtrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the SKN memClrPtr field (hex). The field value is position-data-relative.

MemClrSzeFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the SKN memClrSze field (hex). This field holds the total byte size of the runtime destination buffer.

MemClrPtrValue.description: Raw position-data-relative memClrPtr value. It is independent of GPL section layout and model relocation.

MemClrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the runtime destination (memClr) buffer (hex), computed as submesh 0 position-data address + MemClrPtrValue.

MemClrSize.description: Total byte size of the runtime destination buffer (the contiguous region that receives all deformed vertex positions and normals).

FlushIndArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the SKN flushIndArr field (hex). Points to the flush index array used to invalidate cache lines after skinning.

FlushIndAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the flush index array (hex), or null if the pointer is zero (no flush array present).

FlushIndSize.description: Byte size of the flush index array.

QuantizeInfo.description: Quantization byte shared by all SK1/SK2/SKAcc bind-pose source arrays. High nibble = data format (0/3 = s16, 4/7/0xa = float). Low nibble = right-shift divisor exponent used when encoding s16 values.

SK1s.description: Single-bone influence entries. Each entry drives a set of vertices that are fully weighted to one bone.

BoneIndex.description: Index of the bone that influences all vertices in this entry.

VertexCnt.description: Number of vertices in this SK1 entry.

VertexOffset.description: Byte prefix to skip at the start of VertexArrAbsolutePtr before reading vertex data. Non-zero when vertex data is shared with an adjacent SK entry.

VertexArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the vertexArr pointer field within the SK1 struct (hex). Located at SK1.absolute + 0x30.

GplVertexArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the gplVertexArr field within the SK1 struct (hex). Located at SK1.absolute + 0x34.

VertexArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the bind-pose source data array (hex), computed as SKNOffset + vertexArr.

GplVertexArrValue.description: Byte offset of the first output vertex within the runtime destination buffer. Dividing by the per-vertex byte size gives the GPL-relative global vertex index.

BindPoseData.description: Base64-encoded bind-pose source array. Each vertex contributes 6 components (XYZ position + XYZ normal), packed according to QuantizeInfo. Includes the VertexOffset prefix bytes.

BindPoseDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded bind-pose source array after editing in Blender (in-place export). Written by the Blender exporter; absent until first export. Same layout as BindPoseData but without the VertexOffset prefix.

SK2s.description: Dual-bone influence entries. Each entry drives a set of vertices that are blended between exactly two bones using per-vertex weights.

BoneIndex1.description: Index of the first bone (lower bone id of the pair).

BoneIndex2.description: Index of the second bone (higher bone id of the pair).

VertexCnt.description: Number of vertices in this SK2 entry.

VertexOffset.description: Byte prefix to skip at the start of VertexArrAbsolutePtr before reading vertex data.

VertexArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the vertexArr pointer field within the SK2 struct (hex). Located at SK2.absolute + 0x60.

WeightArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the weightArr pointer field within the SK2 struct (hex). Located at SK2.absolute + 0x64.

GplVertexArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the gplVertexArr field within the SK2 struct (hex). Located at SK2.absolute + 0x68.

VertexArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the bind-pose source data array (hex).

WeightArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the weight array (hex).

GplVertexArrValue.description: Byte offset of the first output vertex within the runtime destination buffer.

BindPoseData.description: Base64-encoded bind-pose source array (6 components per vertex, XYZ + normal, packed by QuantizeInfo). Includes the VertexOffset prefix bytes.

WeightData.description: Base64-encoded weight array. Two uint8 values per vertex; logical contributions use a 256-unit divisor and commonly sum to 256 across all physical records for the vertex.

BindPoseDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded bind-pose source array after editing in Blender (in-place export). Absent until first export.

WeightDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded weight array after editing in Blender (in-place export). Absent until first export.

SKAccs.description: Multi-bone accumulator entries. Each entry contributes a weighted influence from one bone to a set of vertices identified by explicit destination indices. Used for vertices with three or more bone influences.

BoneIndex.description: Index of the bone contributing to these vertices.

VertexCnt.description: Number of vertices in this SKAcc entry.

VertexArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the vertexArr pointer field within the SKAcc struct (hex). Located at SKAcc.absolute + 0x30.

DestArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the destArr pointer field within the SKAcc struct (hex). Located at SKAcc.absolute + 0x34. Points to the uint16 destination index array.

GplDestArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the gplDestArr field within the SKAcc struct (hex). Located at SKAcc.absolute + 0x38.

WeightArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the weightArr pointer field within the SKAcc struct (hex). Located at SKAcc.absolute + 0x3C.

VertexArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the bind-pose source data array (hex).

DestArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the destination index array (hex).

GplDestArrValue.description: Base byte offset within the runtime destination buffer. Each entry in DestIndexData is added to this to get the actual output vertex slot.

WeightArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the weight array (hex).

BindPoseData.description: Base64-encoded bind-pose source array (6 components per vertex, XYZ + normal, packed by QuantizeInfo). No VertexOffset prefix for SKAcc entries.

DestIndexData.description: Base64-encoded destination index array. One big-endian uint16 per vertex identifying the output slot within the destination buffer.

WeightData.description: Base64-encoded uint8 contribution array using a 256-unit divisor. A full accumulated contribution may require duplicate physical records encoded as 255 + 1.

BindPoseDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded bind-pose source array after editing in Blender (in-place export). Absent until first export.

WeightDataEdited.description: Base64-encoded weight array after editing in Blender (in-place export). Absent until first export.

SkinDataEdited.description: Full SKN block representing the edited/rebuilt skinning state. Structurally identical to SkinData so the two blocks can be directly compared before patching. Written by the Blender exporter; absent until first export. Pointer and offset fields are optional (Blender cannot supply them); FlushIndSize should be carried over from SkinData when needed by skn_block_size.

SKNOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the SKN header struct in dt_na.dat (hex). Carried over from SkinData unchanged when written by the Blender exporter.

GplBaseOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the GPL section (hex). Carried over from SkinData.

MemClrPtrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the SKN memClrPtr field (hex). Carried over from SkinData.

MemClrSzeFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the SKN memClrSze field (hex). Carried over from SkinData.

MemClrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the runtime destination buffer (hex). Carried over from SkinData.

MemClrSize.description: Total byte size of the runtime destination buffer. May differ from SkinData.MemClrSize if vertex count changed.

FlushIndArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the SKN flushIndArr field (hex). Carried over from SkinData.

FlushIndAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the flush index array (hex), or null. Carried over from SkinData.

FlushIndSize.description: Number of flush indices. Should be carried over from SkinData.FlushIndSize when computing skn_block_size for the edited block.

SK1s.description: SK1 entries for the edited skinning state. One per bone that has single-influence vertices.

BoneIndex.description: Index of the bone that influences all vertices in this entry.

VertexCnt.description: Number of vertices in this SK1 entry.

VertexOffset.description: Byte prefix to skip at the start of the source array. Always 0 for Blender-exported entries.

VertexArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the vertexArr pointer field (hex). Located at SK1.absolute + 0x30.

GplVertexArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the gplVertexArr field (hex). Located at SK1.absolute + 0x34.

VertexArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the bind-pose source data array (hex).

GplVertexArrValue.description: Byte offset of the first output vertex within the runtime destination buffer.

BindPoseData.description: Base64-encoded bind-pose source array (6 components per vertex, XYZ + normal). No VertexOffset prefix.

SK2s.description: SK2 entries for the edited skinning state. One per unique bone pair that has dual-influence vertices.

BoneIndex1.description: Index of the first bone (lower bone id of the pair).

BoneIndex2.description: Index of the second bone (higher bone id of the pair).

VertexCnt.description: Number of vertices in this SK2 entry.

VertexOffset.description: Byte prefix to skip at the start of the source array. Always 0 for Blender-exported entries.

VertexArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the vertexArr pointer field (hex). Located at SK2.absolute + 0x60.

WeightArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the weightArr pointer field (hex). Located at SK2.absolute + 0x64.

GplVertexArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the gplVertexArr field (hex). Located at SK2.absolute + 0x68.

VertexArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the bind-pose source data array (hex).

WeightArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the weight array (hex).

GplVertexArrValue.description: Byte offset of the first output vertex within the runtime destination buffer.

BindPoseData.description: Base64-encoded bind-pose source array (6 components per vertex, XYZ + normal).

WeightData.description: Base64-encoded weight array. Two bytes per vertex (w1 for BoneIndex1, w2 for BoneIndex2).

SKAccs.description: SKAcc entries for the edited skinning state. One per bone that contributes to vertices with three or more influences.

BoneIndex.description: Index of the bone contributing to these vertices.

VertexCnt.description: Number of vertices in this SKAcc entry.

VertexArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the vertexArr pointer field (hex). Located at SKAcc.absolute + 0x30.

DestArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the destArr pointer field (hex). Located at SKAcc.absolute + 0x34.

GplDestArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the gplDestArr field (hex). Located at SKAcc.absolute + 0x38.

WeightArrFieldOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the weightArr pointer field (hex). Located at SKAcc.absolute + 0x3C.

VertexArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the bind-pose source data array (hex).

DestArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the destination index array (hex).

GplDestArrValue.description: Base byte offset within the runtime destination buffer.

WeightArrAbsolutePtr.description: Resolved absolute address of the weight array (hex).

BindPoseData.description: Base64-encoded bind-pose source array (6 components per vertex, XYZ + normal). No VertexOffset prefix.

DestIndexData.description: Base64-encoded destination index array. One big-endian uint16 per vertex.

WeightData.description: Base64-encoded weight array. One byte per vertex.

ACTHeader.description: ACT (actor) section header fields needed to reconstruct the binary ACT block during hammerspace assembly. Null for purely static meshes that have no ACT section.

ActorID.description: Actor identifier (uint16 at ACT header +0x04). Written into the reconstructed ACT header.

SkinFileID.description: Skin file identifier (uint16 at ACT header +0x14). References the associated SKN/skin file in the game's file table.

GeoName.description: Null-terminated geometry name string pointed to by ACT header +0x10. Stored verbatim in the reconstructed ACT section's string region.

ACTTreeUnknown.description: Unknown uint32 at Tree struct +0x00 (ACT +0x08). Read and discarded by the parser; preserved here for verbatim reconstruction.

BoneHierarchy.description: One entry per bone in the model's ACT (actor) section. Present only for models that have an ACT section with a bone tree. Absent (null) for purely static meshes.

BoneId.description: Unique bone index within this model, matching the id field of the ACT bone layout.

GeoId.description: Index of the geometry submesh this bone is primarily associated with. For skinned bones (Skinned=true) this is always 0 because the geometry file ID in the ACT is 0xFFFF (skinned marker) and is normalised to 0.

ParentBoneId.description: BoneId of this bone's parent, or null if this is a root bone.

Skinned.description: True when the ACT bone layout's geoFileId is 0xFFFF, meaning this bone drives skinned vertex deformation rather than a rigid sub-mesh.

TrackId.description: Animation track index that drives this bone, read from the ACT user-data section.

SRTType.description: Type byte at SRT block +0x00 (values: 0x4, 0x8, 0xc for a full scale/rotation/translation block; 0 when orientationPTR is null). Required to write the SRT block header during ACT reassembly.

SRTOffset.description: Absolute file offset (hex) of this bone's SRT block, computed as the ACT section's absolute offset + orientationPTR. The SRT block stores the bind-pose scale at +0x04 (3 big-endian floats), the rotation quaternion at +0x10, and the translation at +0x20. Null when orientationPTR is 0 (the bone has no SRT block). Used by the in-place patcher to locate where an edited bind-pose scale should be written back.

DrawPriority.description: Render priority for this bone (uint8 at ACTBoneLayout +0x19). Controls draw order for rigid (non-skinned) sub-mesh bones.

InheritTransform.description: Whether this bone inherits its parent's transform (bool at ACTBoneLayout +0x18). Almost always true; exported to allow exact binary reconstruction.

Translation.description: Local translation [X, Y, Z] of this bone relative to its parent, from the SRT block at +0x20 (3 big-endian floats).

Scale.description: Local scale [X, Y, Z] from the SRT block at +0x04 (3 big-endian floats). Typically [1, 1, 1].

Quaternion.description: Local rotation quaternion [W, X, Y, Z] from the SRT block at +0x10. The raw binary stores [X, Y, Z, -W]; this field holds the re-arranged and sign-corrected form used by the Python tools.

HeadPosition.description: Absolute world-space position [X, Y, Z] of the bone origin (head), computed by accumulating all parent transforms. Used as the Blender edit-bone head position during import.

VertexInfluences.description: Per-submesh vertex weight lists for this bone. Each entry groups the vertices of one submesh that this bone influences. Empty for bones that do not directly influence any vertices (e.g. root control bones).

SubmeshIndex.description: Zero-based index into the Submeshes array identifying which submesh these vertex influences belong to.

Influences.description: Base64-encoded packed influence list. Each entry is a big-endian uint16 vertex index followed by a big-endian float weight (0.0–1.0), repeated for every influenced vertex: [uint16 vi, float w, uint16 vi, float w, ...].

BoneHierarchyEdited.description: Rebuilt bone hierarchy produced by the Blender exporter when editing the skeleton in Hammerspace Mode. Mirrors BoneHierarchy but represents the desired new state: bones may be added, removed, or reordered. The patcher uses this array to rebuild the entire ACT section in a new hammerspace chunk. Absent until a hammerspace skeleton export is performed.

BoneId.description: Bone index as it should appear in the rebuilt ACT. Must be unique within this array. When adding new bones, assign IDs that do not conflict with existing ones.

GeoId.description: Geometry submesh index to associate with this bone. Use 0 for skinned bones (the ACT will write 0xFFFF as the geoFileId marker when Skinned=true).

ParentBoneId.description: BoneId of this bone's parent in the rebuilt hierarchy, or null for root bones. Must refer to a BoneId present elsewhere in this array.

Skinned.description: True to mark this bone as a skinned deformation bone (geoFileId written as 0xFFFF in the ACT). False for rigid attachment bones.

TrackId.description: Animation track index to assign to this bone in the rebuilt ACT user-data section.

Translation.description: Local translation [X, Y, Z] of this bone relative to its parent, to be written into the rebuilt SRT block at +0x20.

Scale.description: Local scale [X, Y, Z] to be written into the rebuilt SRT block at +0x04. Use [1, 1, 1] for no scaling.

Quaternion.description: Local rotation quaternion [W, X, Y, Z] to be written into the rebuilt SRT block at +0x10. Stored in binary as [X, Y, Z, -W]; the patcher handles the rearrangement.

VertexInfluences.description: Per-submesh vertex weight lists for this bone in the rebuilt mesh. Same encoding as BoneHierarchy.VertexInfluences. The patcher uses these to rebuild SK1/SK2/SKAcc entries alongside SkinDataEdited.

SubmeshIndex.description: Zero-based index into the Submeshes array.

Influences.description: Base64-encoded packed influence list: big-endian uint16 vertex index + big-endian float weight, repeated per influenced vertex.

RootBoneScaleEdited.description: Optional whole-model scale [X, Y, Z] written by the Blender exporter when the user edits the armature's RootBoneScale property and it differs from [1, 1, 1]. The patcher writes these 3 big-endian floats into the SRT block (+0x04) of the main root bone (the top-level bone with no parent, typically BoneId 0), scaling the entire model. Absent when no root scale was applied. The main root bone is never scale-animated by ANM tracks, so this bind-pose scale is the authoritative runtime scale for all animations.

UseHammerspace.description: Written by the Blender exporter. When true, patch_inplace.py uses writeExpandedMesh to relocate vertex, UV, draw-list, and skin source data into hammerspace chunks so that buffer sizes can change freely. When false or absent, all buffers are patched in-place at their original file offsets and sizes must not change.

ReimportTextures.description: Written by the Blender exporter. Optional; defaults to false when absent. When true, patch_inplace.py re-imports the edited PNGs from the model's tex/ folder and patches the existing image and palette payloads in place at their original offsets, without moving buffers, resizing the TEX section, adding texture slots, or changing texture descriptors. When false or absent, texture behavior is unchanged. Must not be combined with UseHammerspace; a file that enables both is rejected until hammerspace supports rebuilt TEX sections.

facialAttribute.description: One facial attribute record with an indexed GPL mapping and an object-defined number of pose arrays.

RecordAbsoluteOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the attribute record (hex).

EntryCount.description: Number of mapped entries in each pose array.

FormatData.description: Four format bytes: target submesh index, attribute kind (0 auxiliary, 1 position, 2 normal), component count, and component byte width.

SubmeshIndex.description: Target GPL submesh index from format byte 0.

AttributeKind.description: Attribute semantic from format byte 1: 0 auxiliary, 1 position, 2 normal.

ComponentCount.description: Components per mapped entry from format byte 2. Six-component position records interleave XYZ and normal XYZ.

ComponentSize.description: Bytes per component from format byte 3.

RunListAbsoluteOffset.description: Absolute file offset of the run list (hex).

RunListData.description: Original packed run-list bytes, encoded as base64 or a debug byte array.

Runs.description: Decoded GPL index runs. Expanding all runs yields exactly EntryCount indices.

FirstVertex.description: First GPL vertex or normal index in this run (uint16).

VertexCount.description: Number of consecutive indices in this run (uint16).

PoseOffsets.description: Section-relative pose-array offsets (hex). Array length equals the containing object's PoseCount.

PoseAbsoluteOffsets.description: Absolute pose-array file offsets (hex). Array length equals the containing object's PoseCount.

PoseData.description: Original pose buffers. Array length equals the containing object's PoseCount; each buffer length is EntryCount * ComponentCount * ComponentSize. Pose 0 stores absolute rest values; poses 1 and later store displacement vectors relative to pose 0.
